information: Konkurrencen afholder ikke 3x3. Nye deltagere henvises til [First Turns of FTO Denmark 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FirstTurnsofFTODenmark2027) og Generalforsamlingen i februar, men er stadig velkomne her. ----- The competition does not host 3x3. New competitors are referred to [First Turns of FTO Denmark 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FirstTurnsofFTODenmark2027) and the 'Generalforsamling' competition in February, but are also welcome here.
